card.statement:
The algebraicity claim in Lemma 14.2 is not proved in this way in [MV2]. In fact, in order to apply the results of [PY] we only need to know that the reduced subgroup $(\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}})_{\mathrm{red}}$ is of finite type, when $\mathbf{k}$ is an algebraic closure of a finite field. The proof of this claim in the published version of [MV2] is incomplete, but the authors have recently added in the arXiv version of their paper an appendix explaining how to fill this gap. In any case, the prior knowledge of the fact that $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is algebraic will allow us to simplify some later steps of the proof.

The fact that $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is connected implies that $(\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}})_{\mathrm{red}}$ is connected; see [Wa, §6.6].
card.label: Remark 14.3

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
